summary: Read-only static review of the bounded scan-frontier, DirectoryStreamRegistry, and probe continuation changes. The membership-invalidation ordering (invalidateDirectoryPass before synchronizeFrontier, both inside the same slice transaction), the frontier window/durable-row disjointness invariant, foreign-key CASCADE cleanup on generation deletion/abandonment, the registry's lock usage and descriptor lifecycle, and the probe's per-slice cancellation/permit/stall handling all check out on inspection. No confidence >=80 correctness bugs were found in the reviewed diff; one sub-80 observation is noted for awareness only and is not counted as a finding.
evidence: EvidenceStore.swift:337-423 invalidateDirectoryPass runs before synchronizeFrontier inside one slice transaction, so stale rows under a restarted prefix are deleted before fresh discovery is inserted.
EvidenceStore.swift:4405-4413 scan_frontier primary key and ON DELETE CASCADE with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON (3721) give cascade cleanup on generation deletion/abandonment.

EvidenceStore.swift:4529-4603 synchronizeFrontier keeps window and durable rows disjoint: refill removes from scan_frontier what it adds to the window; the scanner appends to the window only below frontierWindowSize.
EvidenceStore.swift:537-552 invalidateDirectoryPass deletes strict descendants from scan_frontier; the restarted directory itself is the window head, never a durable row.
DirectoryMetadataScanner.swift:454-478,502-522,601-616 the three restart triggers remove same-slice entries/passes/discovered under the prefix, record the invalidation, and close the stream first.
DirectoryMetadataScanner.swift:924-1037 registry locking is never nested; every opendir success is stored and every error/eviction/close/deinit path closes the descriptor.
DirectoryMetadataScanner.swift:950-1023 exactly 512 names sort; 513 fall through to streaming, matching the documented contract.
PersistentMonitoringProbe.swift:286-317 cancellation, resource budget, pending changes and a fresh permit are re-acquired before each continuation slice; empty-directory passes count as progress.
EvidenceStore.swift:315-321 the reconciliationToken fence discards a stale in-memory generation after a root reset, so continuation slices cannot overwrite it.
MonitoringLifecycleController.swift:188-191 bounded continuation delay gated on scanStalled.
BoundedFrontierTests.swift:121-187 lost-stream and legacy-spill tests assert exact restart counts, inspected names, unique published sets and row/blob sizes.
ConvergentScanGenerationTests.swift:366-388 the legacy cursor test asserts restart-from-beginning rather than a lexical skip.
